text:
Priya: quick handoff from my shift — summary first: between 06:12-07:05 UTC we saw a regional egress degradation affecting eu-west egress nodes. Impact: p95/p99 latency spikes on /v1/generate and a small burst of 503s for requests routed to eu-west. Dedicated customers in eu-west saw brief 5xx bursts until routing fallback kicked in. overall traffic returned to normal after routing policy change but residual elevate p99 for long sequences persists. I opened a ticket with netops and left notes below.

incident-bot: ALERT: egress.path.degraded eu-west — fired 06:12 UTC — symp: increased tcp retransmits, 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m — severity: P2

Priya: timeline quick bullets:
- 06:12 alert fired (egress.path.degraded)
- 06:14 discovered RMQ backlog on egress-router-3, started draining pods, attempted soft-restart of egress-proxy (no immediate change)
- 06:20 auto-routing policy triggered: fallback routing to paired-region (eu-north -> us-east) for non-EU-data customers
- 06:28 netops acknowledged, running packet capture on egress-router-3
- 06:35 Samir applied temporary routing tweak to prefer alternate egress for hosts with p95>300ms
- 06:45 503 rate reduced to baseline but p99 still ~2x normal for long-seq requests
- 07:00 declared degraded but mitigated; monitoring closely

Samir: I pushed a routing override for a subset of traffic (rollout 10% -> 50%) and scaled up egress-proxy replica count by +2 while we waited on netops. command I ran: 
```
# bump replicas and apply routing override
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/egress-proxy-eu-west --replicas=8
curl -X POST https://router-config/api/v1/overrides -d '{"match":"long_seq_clients","route":"eu-north"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

Samir: saw immediate drop in 503. note: this routing override is temporary — needs rollback once netops fixes the underlying link.

Jordan: netops-bot says packet captures show intermittent BGP withdraws from peering partner; they're coordinating with provider. Netops estimate 2-4 hours for full resolution.

netops-bot: Provider SR# 789102 — BGP instability on peer AS64555 — mitigation: flapping suppression applied, monitoring.

Priya: customer impact: two named customers reported visible errors (Dedicated instances):
- AcmeForms: ~120 failed requests over ~10 minutes, support ticket #INC-4521 opened, oncall-eng-sre notified
- Clipstack: sporadic 503s during large batched embedding uploads, support acknowledged.

Samir: AcmeForms — we increased their routing priority to avoid eu-west for 30m window. They reported recovery at 06:40. I left the override in place for now.

Priya: current state — degraded but mitigated. Key metrics: 
- 503 rate back to <0.1% cluster-wide
- p95 back to normal for short requests, p99 long-seq ~1.8x baseline
- autoscaler healthy, no OOMs or pod restarts observed post-scale

Next actions / handoff items:
- Jordan (primary for next 3h): keep routing override in place until netops confirms stable BGP for 30m+; watch p99 and 5xx dashboards (links below). If 5xx climbs >0.5% for 5m, escalate to oncall-senior.
- Samir (secondary): be ready to roll back override in small increments (50% -> 10% -> 0) once netops gives the all-clear. Also coordinate with support -> follow up on INC-4521 and confirm customer-side recovery.
- Priya: I'll follow up with incident writeup and attach packet capture snapshot to the ticket.

Runbooks / links:
- Routing fallback runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-fallback
- Egress diagnostics playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-diagnostics
- Dashboards: https://app.redwood.monitoring/dashboards/egress-overview, https://app.redwood.monitoring/dashboards/5xx-summary
- Support ticket: https://redwood.internal/support/INC-4521

Jordan: taking primary now. quick notes: I'll keep the override at 50% for 30 minutes then evaluate. If provider reports stability I will start the ramp-down. tagging @Samir when I start ramp-down.

Samir: ack. I'll watch SLO alerts and be on pager for the next 2h.

Priya: final ops notes: no change to dedicated capacity commits, no customer data at risk, KMS/HSM not involved. put this in the morning incident triage doc with timelines. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: thanks Priya — good handoff. I'll post an incident summary after 09:00 UTC once provider confirms stabilization.

incident-bot: incident update posted to #incidents at 07:12 UTC (P2 degraded egress)

Priya: leaving — ping if anything spikes.
